messages:
Alex: Hey team :wave: Quick heads-up — short all-hands tomorrow 10:00am PT. Plan is ops + policy update, timeline for Dedicated GA, last-week incident recap, and a Q&A. Please drop quick Qs here or add to the agenda doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/allhands-brief
calendar-bot: Event created — All-Hands: Ops & Policy — Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 PT. Zoom link in calendar invite. :calendar:
Priya: Can we record and post highlight clips? :record_button:
Alex: Yup, will record and share clips. ops-bot will post recording after the meeting.
Mateo: For incident review, can we include a one-slide timeline + mitigation steps? I can prep it.
Jun: I'll bring the perf graphs and tail-latency numbers for the incident window.
Sophie: Heads-up — security will likely ask about embedding retention defaults and KMS integration.
Laura: On the policy note: draft recommends 30d default retention for ephemeral caches; enterprise customers can opt for longer retention via contract. I'll add a short FAQ to the deck.
Lena: Customer Success — we have two enterprise prospects asking about Private deployment SLAs and on-prem packaging. Want a quick callout.
Priya: Suggest adding 15m office-hours after for deep followups?
Alex: Good call — adding a 15m drop-in right after.
ops-bot: Recording will be posted to #all-hands after the meeting. :white_check_mark:
calendar-bot: Agenda doc updated: https://docs.redwood.ai/agenda-1987654321 — please add any blockers or must-ask Qs there.
Alex: Please react with :thumbsup: if you can attend, or reply with conflicts. Trying to keep it tight — 45m presentation + 15m Q&A.
Priya: +1 :thumbsup:
Mateo: Conflict — client demo overlap, will watch recording and leave comments.
Jun: +1, will be there live.
Sophie: Dropping a quick Q here: will we surface the rollout schedule for GA in the public product page or only in the docs?
Alex: We'll do an internal window first and then a public blog post the week after GA; will confirm dates tomorrow.
Laura: FYI: I'll call out the audit logging changes and KMS workflow in the policy slide — want to make sure privacy folks are looped.
Lena: Thanks — I'll have CS prep the customer-facing FAQ for handoff.
Alex: Thanks everyone — last chance to drop must-have questions. I'll stitch these into the deck and share a final version an hour before the meeting.
